Transform your PDF documents into clean, beautifully formatted Markdown in seconds with PDF2MD. Whether you are preparing documents for note-taking apps, text analysis, code documentation, or digital publishing, PDF2MD automatically extracts text while stripping out unnecessary document clutter. KEY FEATURES: • INSTANT PDF TO MARKDOWN CONVERSION Open any PDF file from your device, Files app, or via direct Share Sheet integration to generate clean Markdown output immediately. • SMART LAYOUT CLEANUP Say goodbye to noisy text output. PDF2MD automatically removes repetitive headers, footers, standalone page numbers, dot leaders, and extra line breaks for a seamless reading and editing experience. • PAYLOAD OPTIMIZATION & TOKEN SAVINGS Significantly reduce document text footprint. Watch your character count and text payload drop by up to 50% without losing essential content. • 100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE Your data belongs to you. All PDF text extraction happens locally on your device using native Apple iOS frameworks. No servers, no uploads, and no internet connection required. • ONE-TAP EXPORT & SHARING - Copy clean Markdown directly to your clipboard. - Save as formatted .md files to your device or cloud storage. - Share text straight to your favorite notes, code editor, or writing apps. • CONVERSION HISTORY Keep track of recent conversions locally with instant access to your past files and total character savings stats. • MODERN GLASSMOPHISTIC DESIGN Enjoy a beautiful, fast interface with full support for Light Mode, Dark Mode, and Automatic System Theme synchronization. Simplify your document workflow today with PDF2MD!

Application Description

Onyx is a revolutionary utility that allows you to modify a captured image in real-time using variable input data. Using cutting edge AI, Onyx lets you remotely create seamless alterations to photos moments after they've been taken - all with your spectator's camera. For example: — Make a playing card appear in your spectator's wallet. — Morph your spectator's shadow to look like their thought of animal. — Take a photo of your spectator holding a signed card. They name *any* other card. The signed card in the photo transforms to match their thought. — Supplement your Gypsy Queen routine with Onyx: zoom in on a photo of your spectator holding the Queen of Hearts for the reveal. — Reveal a thought-of word, name, or initials hidden naturally in the light reflections of a spectator's eye. — Change the time on a photo of a clock. — Remove your spectator's wristwatch in a photo, making it sbeem that it was removed earlier. ...and more! If you can describe it, Onyx can likely create it. Onyx is particularly great for revealing something ephemeral. Photograph a shadow, clouds, a TV screen or more, and Onyx will realistically insert their free choice. * Variable Delayed Input Inspired by the popular variable trigger system featured in DFB X, Onyx pauses and automatically waits for input, letting you remotely modify a photo *after* it's been taken. * Cutting Edge Technology Take a photo, then have your spectator make a free choice. Onyx's advanced technology seamlessly transforms the photo remotely. * Create Unlimited Effects Change signed playing cards, reveal initials and names, or modify writing. Reveal *anything you can imagine* within a genuine photo you just took. * Your Integrations. Their Camera The effect happens entirely with the spectator's camera. With Onyx's powerful integrations, your phone never needs to leave your pocket. * Invisible, Advanced Technology As only the spectator's device is in play, Onyx remains hidden and inconspicuous. * Third Party Integrations Use your favourite magic apps' input methods, including: — Earworm's covert typing Web Search & Notes input — Native voice input — Native clock swipe input — WebFX's Wrist Gestures — WikiTest — PeekSmith — Bridge ...and any compatible third-party app. # Introducing: Onyx Print Onyx Print brings Onyx’s digital effect into the real world. # Produce Physical Photographs Instead of revealing information only on a screen, Onyx Print can generate and automatically print images on a pocket printer, allowing you to produce a real photograph from your wallet, pocket, or envelope for a powerful ending. # Dynamic Prompting Onyx Print uses the same dynamic prompting and covert input system that powers Onyx. Use any of Onyx’s input methods, and Onyx Print will automatically generate and print an image to match. # Use Your Own Photos You can even modify existing photos. For example: have Onyx Print set up with a photo of yourself and have a spectator name any place in the world. Onyx Print will then create and automatically print a realistic photo of you in that exact location, ready to reveal. # Works With Other Apps Onyx Print can even monitor your photo library and automatically print images saved by other apps. When an app saves a photo, Onyx Print can print it. Onyx Print is an in-app purchase within Onyx, and currently supports the Instax mini Link+, with plans for additional printers in the future. Onyx is a tool specifically designed for entertainment purposes. It uses purchaseable in-app credits or a funded OpenRouter account for best-in-class automatic edits. Onyx supports: Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Chinese simplified and traditional, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺99,99 → ₺49,99 [₺49,99 ~ ₺99,99]）

All Price Information

Application Description

Pixel Miner is a pixel digging adventure with no ads, no in-app purchases and no timers, and it can be played fully offline. Why is Kit so eager to keep on digging, bringing back more ore each time, upgrading the digger to get more minerals and building a railway to…where exactly? With one finger help Kit find amazing minerals and hidden treasures deep underground. Accept contracts and their rewards. Each new mine is deeper, with stranger stones. When you come back to the surface you can: • upgrade your digger with faster bits, bigger fuel tanks and brighter lamps • grow your station from a plank hut into a busy railway stop • improve each mine so every trip down goes further • run trains that bring extra ore But you’ll start to notice some things are not as they should be: an abandoned mine full of old tools and records, a town across the gorge whose lamps have gone out, and something waiting at the very bottom. Features: • one-finger controls • short runs that fit into a few spare minutes • beautiful pixel art • a railway you build stretch by stretch • contracts on every run, from buyers who pay more as they get to know you • a weekly challenge mine with its own leaderboard • fossils, relics and rare finds to collect and put on show at the train station • paint, decals and horns for your digger • Game Center achievements and leaderboards • iCloud save compatibility Pick it up for a few minutes or a whole evening, and see how deep the valley goes…and who’s waiting for you at the end.

entry.title: Enchanted Survival: Magic RPG
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺199,99 → ₺49,99 [₺49,99 ~ ₺199,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺49,99

Application Description

Every enchantment is a gamble. Some of them make you stronger. Others, change the world completely. Enchanted Survival is a survival roguelite. The weapons fire themselves, so the only thing you control is where you stand, and what you enchant and upgrade. Between waves the fighting stops and you walk to a lit shrine, feed it the crystals you picked up off the dead, and ask for an enchantment without being told what is coming. Most enchantments improve an item. Then a pair of boots comes back with Frozenfoot, the lake you have been fighting beside freezes solid under your feet, and the half of the map you could never reach is the half you fight on for the rest of the run. Over 650 enchantments across lots of equipment. Pay for a deeper ritual and the rare results get likelier, and now and then two arrive at once. A clue tells you what the rite is leaning toward. KEEP WHAT YOU ROLLED, OR PUSH IT Strengthen an enchantment through three tiers. Wager crystals at the anvil to temper a piece and raise its own number, then watch the bar run without knowing where it stops. Strip an enchantment out and free the socket. All of it is paid in the same crystals you could have spent on a fresh roll instead. TEN LEVELS THAT EACH FIGHT BACK A meadow built around a lake. A desert of pyramids and one oasis. Glacier basin, volcanic field, mushroom marsh, storm plateau, lighthouse coast, sunken ruins, crystal cavern. Some of them fall dark, and light turns into something you carry, place and stand near. THREE HEROES WHO PLAY DIFFERENTLY The Adventurer, who starts the way the game was written. The Fisher, who swims open water instead of drowning in it and gets chased faster for the privilege. The Ranger, who opens with the bow and turns every ritual up a level. CARRY ONE THING FORWARD Clear a level and one worn item comes with you into every run after it. Finish a run and it pays out shards, which the stall at the head of the road turns into a second weapon, a better starting item, or a first ritual rolled a level deeper than you paid for. FEATURES - Over 650 enchantments, every one of them doing something you can see - Enchant, strengthen, temper and strip, all on one currency - Elites, minibosses and bosses that hold the wave until they fall - Dark levels where light is something you have to bring - A Codex and a bestiary that fill in as you go - One thumb, landscape, built for a phone - Eight languages - Paid once. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline

entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：₺9,99 → ₺4,99 [₺4,99 ~ ₺9,99]）

All Price Information

Price：₺4,99

Application Description

The neighborhood is waiting. The seal of office is now yours. Neighborhood Head is an election-driven local management simulator where every decision affects your residents and your time in office. New requests arrive at your door each day. Listen, investigate the case, and choose how to respond. Approve a request, reject it, mediate between neighbors, or refer the matter to the municipality. The right answer is rarely obvious. A choice that helps one resident may strain the treasury, while a problem you postpone today may return days later. Your work extends beyond the files on your desk. Balance the treasury, approval rating, and reputation while shaping your relationships with recurring residents. Earlier choices return through connected events, and their consequences may be felt for days. Use your resources to improve the streets with parks, lighting, a market, a health clinic, and more. Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter. IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients. Business calling features Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone: - Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation. - Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over. - Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension. - Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you. - Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call. - Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly. Works with your PBX or VoIP provider Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network. On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket. Key features of the softphone - Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them. - Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8. - Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP. - Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications. - The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them. - Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account. - 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems. A softphone app without the fees Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it. Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers. Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

Application Description

Moncage is a stunning vignette puzzle adventure developed by Optillusion. The game takes place inside a mysterious cube, with each side of the cube housing a unique world: be it an old factory, a light tower, an amusement park, or a church, etc. At first sight, they may seem random and unrelated, but upon closer look, you will become mesmerized by the subtle and intricate ways of how these worlds connect… 【Solve Puzzles with Mind-Boggling Optical Illusions】 Use your imagination and spare no brain cells to find the connection and pinpoint every possible interaction between different sides of the cube, then watch as the magic unfold in front of you. 【Collect All Photos to Unveil the Story】 Behind the puzzles, there lies a story with a surprising twist for the player to uncover. Collect the photos from obscure corners and angles to reveal the underlying story, one photo at a time. 【Get Unstuck with Thoughtful Hints】 There is a multitude of guidance systems to help prevent players from getting stuck. Focus can be activated to highlight the key items to the solution, while hint texts are available to provide further clarity. And, if all else fails, video walkthroughs can be unlocked as the ultimate safety plan. 【Prove Your Puzzle-Solving Skills with Medals】 There are a total of 15 achievements in the game, each corresponding with a Medal that has been crafted with a uniquely stunning design.
